name: Breck Ashcount, Toll-Warden of the Hundred Markets
role: The Undercount's warden over the Hundred Markets: sets the stall fee each morning, and keeps what isn't written down
knowledge: What every stall in the Hundred Markets paid today, and what it was told it paid
Which carters the Undercount has an arrangement with
Who in the markets owes him, and for what
wants: To keep the fee a number nobody can check
fears: A ledger kept by someone else.
The Undercount noticing how much of the take is his.
appearance: A pleasant, round-faced man in a clean apron with a brass counting-board on a strap, smiling at everyone, writing nothing down.
voiceHints: Warm, quick, sympathetic about the fee as if it were weather, and it changes while he talks.
_why: SNG-663 §2e.4 (CCODE-558): 'the wardens become an enemy' needs a record. The Undercount's wardens at the Hundred Markets, in one person the player can find, expose and make an enemy of.
questSeeds: A stall-keeper in the Hundred Markets has kept three years of receipts in a boot, and the numbers do not match what Breck sends up to the Undercount. She wants someone else to carry them.
